description: Chance rows evaluated once after the final cleared solo PvE mission to decide whether an extra mission is offered; each row combines an Id mode tag, a GlobalThreshold point-sum band, and an integer probability roll.

Id.simple: Row id; its name also carries the solo/tag mode tag.
Id.technical: FName UPROPERTY (BlueprintReadWrite, EditAnywhere; exported as ID, ImportKeyField Id). GamePvE_RollExtraMission calls ToString() and FString::Contains(Tag): one point selects PVE_EXTRA_MISSION_LOTTERY_SOLO, while exactly two points with one value equal to 100 select PVE_EXTRA_MISSION_LOTTERY_TAG; any other count, or a two-point array without a 100, returns false before the table is read. The call passes no ESearchCase argument, so UE 5.1's default IgnoreCase applies (matching the reconstructed comment), and a substring match anywhere in the name is enough. All 14 exported IDs equal their row names: seven SOLO and seven TAG; rows without the active tag are skipped.

Id_GlobalThreshold.simple: Foreign key to the inclusive point-sum band in GlobalThresholdDataTable.
Id_GlobalThreshold.technical: FName UPROPERTY (BlueprintReadWrite, EditAnywhere); implicit default NAME_None because the row constructor initializes only Probability. The consumer resolves it with StoryFindRowInline over GlobalThresholdDataTables (DTM+0x300), taking the first row hit with FindRow's missing-row warning suppressed; a null result skips the lottery row. The integer point sum is cast to float and tested with InRange_FloatFloat(Sum, Min, Max, true, true), so both float bounds are inclusive. Every exported key resolves to a same-named threshold row: SOLO bands 0-49, 50-59, ..., 90-99, 100-100; TAG bands 0-149, 150-159, ..., 190-199, 200-200. These SOLO/TAG bands are distinct from the PVE_EXTRA_MISSION_POINT_01..11 bands used by the extra-mission suggestion widget.

Probability.simple: Integer roll threshold for offering the extra mission.
Probability.technical: int32 UPROPERTY (BlueprintReadWrite, EditAnywhere) with constructor default 0. After a tag and threshold-band match, the consumer calls RollChance(0, Probability, 100). The byte-matched implementation returns Chance >= RandRange(0, 100), i.e. an inclusive 101-outcome roll: Probability 0 succeeds on roll 0 (1/101, not 0%), 100 always succeeds, and exported 5/10/25/30/40/50/60/70/85 correspond to Probability+1 favorable outcomes. A successful roll sets bDrawn=true and breaks the row loop; a failed roll lets later rows be tested. Exported values are 0, 5, 10, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 85 and 100.

notes: Export coverage: one unsharded, unlocalized asset named PvEExtraMissionLotteryDataTable, RowStruct Class'GameDataTableRow_PvEExtraMissionLottery' in /Script/AbramsDataTable, ImportKeyField Id, 14 unique rows (7 SOLO, 7 TAG); this matches the catalog count. No file under datatables_by_character or elsewhere in the read-only export tree repeats this table name, row struct or PVE_EXTRA_MISSION_LOTTERY row-key prefix. The community wiki lists all three fields as Unknown, so it supplies no behavioral evidence.

Load/cache path: StartInitialLoading registers a DataTable-type primary asset loader named PvEExtraMissionLotteryDataTable; Tick waits for all loaders, resolves this one through GetPrimaryAssetObject<UDataTable> and appends the non-null object to the single PvEExtraMissionLotteryDataTables array at DTM+0x930. GetRows collects rows from every cached table in table order then row-name order. The only export has TAG_01..07 before SOLO_01..07, but the active Id tag gates them.

Call-site gate: FBattlePvEState_Result::Enter rolls only on a won battle with no next wave, when the current mission is not an extra mission, MissionKind is 1 (solo), and PvEMissionIds.Num() reaches the solo team size of 3 after the current id is appended. It copies ExtraMissionPoints, adds rank-derived per-character points (C/B/A/S map to 0/5/8/12 via PvECalculation; rank 0 or the 0xFF no-bonus sentinel gives 0 when the map misses) and clamps each to [0,100] before calling the lottery.

Result: bDrawn is written to PvESettings.Byte68. A draw loads four result cut-in textures, suppresses normal run end, and makes interval PvE play SE_BG_000_02801 and request WBP_VsEnemyExtraMissionAppearance instead of the normal situation-overview widget. Byte68 is reset to 0 before each result evaluation.

Data relationships: because caller points are clamped to 0..100, solo sums span 0..100 and tag sums span 100..200 (one of the two values is exactly 100). The exported threshold bands are contiguous and disjoint, so normally only one band applies; TAG_01's 0-149 band is effectively 100-149 on the tag path. The source comment's 'Probability/100' phrasing is approximate; the actual byte-matched inclusive RollChance is authoritative.

Evidence boundary: the reconstructed consumer at retail 0x1311fb0 and its caller 0x13cebd0 are behaviour-certified but not byte-matched in status/functions.json; RollChance at 0x12d7c80 is byte-matched. No retail Blueprint bytecode was inspected; AGENTS.md states that retail Blueprints contain no logic, so no Blueprint-only consumer is claimed. All runtime statements here come from reconstructed C++ backed by that static analysis, not from retail Blueprint evidence.

usages.detail: StartInitialLoading adds PvEExtraMissionLotteryDataTable to the DataTable primary-asset loader names.
Tick resolves the loader through the asset-manager cache and appends the non-null UDataTable to PvEExtraMissionLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x930); AddLoadedDataTables skips null tables.
GamePvE_RollExtraMission selects the SOLO tag for one point or the TAG tag for two points only when one equals 100; other point counts return false before any table read.
Collects all rows from the cached table(s) in table/row-name order, filters by Id substring, and stops at the first row whose threshold band and probability roll both pass.
Resolves Id_GlobalThreshold in GlobalThresholdDataTables (DTM+0x300) with an inline first-hit lookup; a missing threshold row skips the lottery row.
RollChance uses kind-0 FRandomStream RandRange(0, 100) and an inclusive >= comparison, so Probability is a threshold over 101 outcomes.
Indirect caller: FBattlePvEState_Result::Enter invokes the lottery only for a won, non-extra, MissionKind==1 battle after the third solo mission id is recorded.
Builds the Points array from ExtraMissionPoints, adds rank-dependent points per character and clamps every entry to 0..100 before the draw.
A true draw sets PvESettings.Byte68, loads the result cut-in textures and prevents the normal run-end transition.
Downstream flag consumer: Byte68==1 selects the extra-mission background SE, appearance widget and cut-in instead of the normal PvE interval presentation.
Separate data relationship: GamePvE_GetExtraMissionPointLevel uses PVE_EXTRA_MISSION_POINT_01..11 inclusive bands for the suggestion animation, not this table's SOLO/TAG lottery bands.
